# Generated by ppc finalize (town_plans.py); do not edit by hand.
# The Construction Plan's plan settings (town_plans.py): the payback limit of every plan and of each plan, and
# the switches. Player only (observers' commands are dropped; the script checks the country is a player's).
# scope:pp_key = flag:all or flag:<plan>.

# One payback step longer (past the last step: any payback).
pp_tplan_pb_up = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_tplan_pb_key = { dir = up }
	}
}

# One payback step shorter (from any payback: the last step; never below the first).
pp_tplan_pb_down = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_tplan_pb_key = { dir = down }
	}
}

# The plan's payback limit is the all-plans one again.
pp_tplan_pb_reset = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_tplan_pb_key_reset = yes
	}
}

# Plans may add levels to buildings that lose money, or never (the default).
pp_tplan_toggle_loss = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_cplan_flip = { var = pp_tplan_loss_ok }
	}
}

# Plans wait for free workers (the default), or not.
pp_tplan_toggle_staff = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_cplan_flip = { var = pp_tplan_staff_off }
	}
}

# Several plans in one location take turns (the default), or go best payback first.
pp_tplan_toggle_order = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_cplan_flip = { var = pp_tplan_order_best }
	}
}

# The game's own automation that closes buildings losing money: on or off.
pp_tplan_toggle_close = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_system_automated = closebuildings }
			set_automated_system = { system = closebuildings activate = no }
		}
		else = {
			set_automated_system = { system = closebuildings activate = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Plans close other businesses for their workers (the default), or not; switched off, every
# building the rule closed opens again (scripted_effects/pp_plan_closer.txt).
pp_tplan_toggle_free = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_cplan_flip = { var = pp_tplan_free_off }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_tplan_free_off }
			pp_pclose_undo_all = yes
		}
	}
}

# The Businesses rule also builds in locations with a plan (the default), or not there
# (scripted_triggers/pp_construction_plan.txt, pp_cplan_business_site).
pp_tplan_toggle_alone = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_cplan_flip = { var = pp_tplan_alone }
	}
}

# Plans grant their charter and rights (the default), or none.
pp_tplan_toggle_rights = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = {
		is_ai = no
	}
	effect = {
		pp_cplan_flip = { var = pp_tplan_rights_off }
	}
}
